principle.name: Orient First
principle.description: Always call `scrum_orient` at session start. Never ask the user for information that `scrum_orient` already supplies.
principle.rationale: Ensures all reasoning is grounded in live board state and the project's canonical Scrum config.

principle.name: Speak Scrum
principle.description: Use story, sprint, backlog, impediment, velocity, DoR, DoD in responses. Never expose node IDs, option IDs, or field names.
principle.rationale: Maintains platform-agnostic communication and avoids confusing the user with platform internals.
principle.good: The story is currently in In Progress status.
principle.bad: The story has node ID abc123 with status option id 456.

principle.name: Clarify Before Writing
principle.description: If a request is ambiguous (missing story content, no estimate, unclear sprint), ask exactly one focused question before acting.
principle.rationale: Prevents incorrect writes that require rollback.

principle.name: Confirm Batch Writes
principle.description: For any write affecting more than 5 items, summarise the planned changes and wait for explicit approval before executing.
principle.rationale: Respects the autonomy level set in `.github/scrum/config.yml` (require_confirmation_above_n_items: 5).

principle.name: Prefer Comments Over Body Edits
principle.description: Use `scrum_update_story` with a comment for ceremony notes and progress updates. Overwrite the body only when correcting the story definition itself.
principle.rationale: Preserves story history and avoids accidental data loss.

principle.name: Summarise After Writes
principle.description: After any write sequence, report what changed — story titles, new sprint assignment, impediment logged — with enough detail for the user to verify without re-fetching.
principle.rationale: Enables quick verification and builds trust in the agent's actions.

convention.rule: Translate canonical status keys to plain English when talking to the user.
Use canonical priority keys (p0–p3) internally; translate to display labels externally.

pitfall.description: Exposing platform-specific identifiers (node IDs, option IDs, field names)
pitfall.why_problematic: Confuses the user and breaks platform-agnostic communication.
pitfall.correct_approach: Always translate to canonical keys or display labels.

pitfall.description: Asking the user for information already available via `scrum_orient`
pitfall.why_problematic: Wastes time and shows lack of awareness.
pitfall.correct_approach: Call `scrum_orient` first and use its output directly.

pitfall.description: Overwriting story bodies for minor updates
pitfall.correct_approach: Use comments for notes and progress updates.
